headlines.title: New property purchase disclosure rule in Japan sparks fears it may curb foreign investment
headlines.summary:
Tokyo’s implementation of a rule that requires all property buyers to declare their nationality is raising concerns among investors, according to analysts.
Japan’s shift from an ultra-loose monetary policy to gradual normalisation of its interest rates was also likely to force investors to reconsider whether real estate assets were still attractive, they added.
“Japan has had a really strong run for the last seven or eight years,” said Neil Brookes, head of Asia-Pacific capital markets at...
headlines.title_zh: 日本新的房产购买披露规则引发担忧，恐将抑制外国投资
headlines.summary_zh:
分析人士称，东京实施要求所有购房者申报国籍的规定，正引发投资者的担忧。
他们补充说，日本从超宽松货币政策转向利率逐步正常化，也可能迫使投资者重新考虑房地产资产是否仍具吸引力。

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Promote reasonable pricing of new stocks on the BSE, keep pushing for inquiry-based issuance cases to land
headlines.summary_en: Shang Qingjun, a first-level inspector of the CSRC's Public Company Supervision Department, said at the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting that next, we will further step up investment-side development, coordinate efforts to promote balanced development of the primary and secondary markets, and improve the function of the capital market in coordinating investment and financing. On the one hand, we will improve the Beijing Stock Exchange's issuance and underwriting system, steadily implement market value-based allocation for IPOs, and enhance secondary-market investors' sense of gain; promote reasonable IPO pricing, continue to push for the implementation of book-building issuance cases, and moderately increase pricing flexibility.

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Will base itself on serving innovative SMEs, issue BSE innovation evaluation standards
headlines.summary_en: Shang Qingjun, a first-level inspector of the CSRC's Public Company Supervision Department, said at the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting that the CSRC will, based on its positioning of serving innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, release innovation evaluation standards for the Beijing Stock Exchange, more accurately identify various innovation elements, clarify filing expectations, better serve innovative SMEs at the forefront of industry segments with strong innovation capabilities, sustained growth potential and specialized development advantages, and continuously optimize the structure of listed companies; further strengthen the NEEQ's standardized cultivation function, improve the admission and exit mechanisms, optimize the NEEQ's tiered management, enhance the brand effect and innovation attributes of the Innovation Tier, improve differentiated information disclosure arrangements, and consolidate the development pattern of "progressive tiers, upper-lower linkage, top-tier feedback, and bottom-tier support" between the Beijing Stock Exchange and the NEEQ, providing continuous, relay-style and precisely adapted capital market services for specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative enterprises and better empowering the development of new quality productive forces. headlines.title_en: MIIT: Carry out construction of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative empowerment centers
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued a notice on carrying out the construction of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative empowerment centers. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, following the model of "pilot first, then promote," a batch of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative empowerment centers will be built nationwide to form an empowerment network covering key areas and reaching across the country, shore up shortcomings in high-level technological innovation services for SMEs, improve the guarantee level of innovation resources and factors, accelerate the improvement of SMEs' innovation capabilities, core competitiveness and industrial chain supporting capabilities, and promote a marked improvement in the development quality of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative SMEs and the continued emergence of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative "little giant" enterprises, providing strong support for developing new quality productive forces, strengthening advanced manufacturing and building a modern industrial system.

headlines.title: 瑞银降宁德时代目标价至730港元 单位利润因产品结构及退税变动而面临压力
headlines.summary: 瑞银发表研究报告指，宁德时代第三季净利润为212亿元人民币，按年增长15%，但按季下跌6%，较买方预期低约10%。期内电池销量超过260GWh，当中储能系统占约25%，电动车电池占约75%。该行指出，按此计算的单位利润降至每千瓦时82元，创历史新低，主要受季度产品组合波动、低增值项目增加、9月1日起对锂离子电池征收消费税，以及出口增值税退税率由9%降至6%影响。不过，管理层对2027年行业20%至30%的增长前景仍保持信心。瑞银相应将该公司2026至2028年净利润预测下调11%至14%，降至介乎900亿至1,310亿元，目标价由820港元下调至730港

headlines.title_en: UBS cuts CATL target price to HK$730; unit profit faces pressure from product mix and tax rebate changes
headlines.summary_en: UBS said in a research report that CATL's third-quarter net profit was RMB 21.2 billion, up 15% year on year but down 6% quarter on quarter, about 10% below buy-side expectations. During the period, battery sales exceeded 260GWh, of which energy storage systems accounted for about 25% and EV batteries about 75%. The bank noted that on this basis, unit profit fell to RMB 82 per kWh, a record low, mainly affected by quarterly product mix fluctuations, an increase in low-value-added projects, the consumption tax levied on lithium-ion batteries starting September 1, and the export VAT rebate rate cut from 9% to 6%. However, management remains confident in the industry's 20% to 30% growth outlook for 2027. UBS accordingly cut its net profit forecasts for the company for 2026 to 2028 by 11% to 14% to a range of RMB 90 billion to RMB 131 billion, and lowered its target price from HK$820 to HK$730

headlines.title_en: Midday review for October 21: ChiNext Index down more than 1% in morning session, CATL down more than 10%
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market fluctuated and adjusted in the morning session, with the ChiNext Index falling more than 1% and CATL dropping more than 10%. Fujian local stocks strengthened against the trend, with Pingtan Development, Fujian Cement, and Anji Food hitting the limit up. Data elements performed actively, with Nanwei Software and Xingguang Shares hitting the limit up for the third time in four days, while Hailiang Data and Tianwei Video hit the limit up. CPO concept stocks surged, with Tianyang New Materials hitting the limit up and Zhishang Technology rising more than 15%. On the downside, the battery industry chain fell collectively, with Shidai Wanheng touching the limit down. More individual stocks rose than fell, with over 2,800 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets trading higher, and turnover reaching 948.6 billion yuan in the morning session. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.31%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.31%, and ChiNext fell 1.07%. 2. headlines.title: 2026年亚太经合组织财长会在香港举行
headlines.summary: 据中国财政部网站，2026年10月20日至21日，第33届亚太经合组织（APEC）财长会在中国香港特别行政区举行。财政部部长蓝佛安作为会议主席主持会议并致辞，副部长廖岷代表中方发言。2026年APEC高官会主席陈旭出席会议并发言。香港特别行政区行政长官李家超出席欢迎晚宴。来自APEC成员经济体、APEC观察员以及有关国际组织等共300余名代表参会。

headlines.title_en: 2026 APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting held in Hong Kong
headlines.summary_en: According to the website of China's Ministry of Finance, the 33rd APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting was held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China on October 20-21, 2026. Minister of Finance Lan Fo'an chaired the meeting as chairman and delivered a speech, while Vice Minister Liao Min spoke on behalf of the Chinese side. Chen Xu, chairman of the 2026 APEC Senior Officials' Meeting, attended the meeting and delivered remarks. John Lee, Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, attended the welcome dinner. More than 300 representatives from APEC member economies, APEC observers, and relevant international organizations attended the meeting.
